name: Higashikyoto Chris no Jikenbo ~File 02: Injuu~
original_name: 東京都繰子の事件簿 ～File02：淫獣～
source:
Japan was in a modern boom. It was some years after the war.
An inheritance gave Chris Higashikyoto the funds to pursue her job as a detective, but with no work to do the days were lazy.
Then one day, a single client came to her.

Mineko Tsuchibami.

"It's my husband... Tetsuma, he's disappeared..."

Something seemed off about her story, but Chris listened.

"I think someone has been spying on us."

The cogwheels began to turn.

Tetsuma Tsuchibami. He was a well-known novelist. His publishing agent Shintaro was quick to take advantage of the missing husband situation. He put the moves on Mineko.
Turns out Tetsuma was flaccid down there. Mineko was certainly yearning for satisfaction, but she was a dedicated wife. At first, she rejected Shintaro.
In spite of her resoluteness she couldn't match Shintaro's trickery, and her will eventually crumbled.
She tasted the fruit of pleasure, and her body sang.

Fingers. Tongue. No inch of their adulterous flesh went unexplored.
As a woman, in her husband's bed, she gave nightly birth to cries of ecstasy in the embrace of another man.

Carnality that was watched... by someone...

Join Chris on a hot case of tantalizing, mysterious noir crime.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109055.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
战后数年，日本正经历现代化的繁荣。
Chris Higashikyoto凭借继承的遗产，得以从事侦探工作，却因为没有委托而整日无所事事。
直到某一天，一位委托人来到她面前。

土喰美祢子。

“是我丈夫……Tetsuma，他失踪了……”

她的说法似乎有些不对劲，但Chris还是听了下去。

“我觉得，有人一直在偷窥我们。”

命运的齿轮开始转动。

Tetsuma Tsuchibami是一位知名小说家。他的出版代理人Shintaro趁着丈夫失踪，迅速向美祢子发起攻势。
原来，Tetsuma性功能不振。美祢子确实渴望得到满足，但她忠于丈夫，起初拒绝了Shintaro。
然而，无论她多么坚定，都敌不过Shintaro的诡计，意志最终崩溃了。
她品尝了欢愉的果实，身体也随之欢唱。

手指，舌头。他们通奸的肉体没有一寸不被探索。
她作为女人，在丈夫的床上，夜夜投入另一个男人的怀抱，发出狂喜的呻吟。

而这一切肉欲……都被某个人看在眼里……

与Chris一同调查这桩诱人而神秘的黑色犯罪案件吧。
